description: Worth stating plainly rather than implying: current Node and WSGI both reject control characters in header values, so on those runtimes this is defence in depth rather than a live break. It is reported because the code is wrong wherever it is deployed, and the ledger says which of those two things is being claimed. The obsolete-function rule is about a specific API and a specific reason -- createCipher derives its key with one unsalted MD5 -- rather than about deprecation in general, which no rule can infer.

expected.note: the caller's text becomes part of a header value
superseded because its key derivation is a single unsalted MD5
